description: Header file declaring persistence-related functions for WLD features, including start, radio creation, write, and initialization check functions.

methods.name: wld_persist_onStart
methods.description: Function to handle startup persistence operations.

methods.name: wld_persist_onRadioCreation
methods.description: Function called upon radio creation, takes a T_Radio pointer.

methods.name: wld_persist_writeApAtCreation
methods.description: Function to write access point data at creation.

methods.name: wld_persist_isRadInitConfigPending
methods.description: Function to check if radio initialization configuration is pending, takes a T_Radio pointer.
